name: ticket-booking-system
description: Ticket Booking System monorepo root: one-command install, test, lint and verification across the backend (Express + MySQL) and frontend (React + Vite) stacks. See README.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:web
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run lint:root && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:repo && npm test
